bulwark.name: bulwark
bulwark.description: Read-only Linux hardening auditor with a terminal UI. Checks SSH, firewall, permissions, kernel settings, and patching against CIS-inspired controls, scores your system, and shows how to fix each finding.

termwerm.name: termwerm
termwerm.description: Zero-bloat TUI to audit function complexity and efficiency across codebases. Fast, keyboard-driven, and plain-English.

blamey.name: blamey
blamey.description: A simple way to see how much each contributer really added to the project
